author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the launch trailer for Battle Birds, a classic arcade-inspired game developed by Cowmaster Studios. Battle Birds is a local multiplayer arcade shooter for up to 4 players where cybernetic birds flap, dash, and blast each other across hazardous arenas filled with explosive power-ups. Battle Birds is out now on PC.
title: Battle Birds - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan and step into an interactive reimagining of the popular Taiwanese soap opera THE BONFIRE OF TAIWAN. Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan puts you in control of the narrative, allowing you to guide the beloved characters to endings from the original show, complete with unlockable live-action clips of iconic scenes, or make choices that lead to unique game-exclusive outcomes! Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan launches on PC (Steam) on December 2, 2026, with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The Heartopia × My Little Pony Phase 2 Collaboration Trailer is here! The Windigos have threatened the Tree of Harmony, and Heartopia players need to join forces to cleanse it and restore its light. The event brings four new Outfits, two Vehicles, and themed furniture to Heartopia; all Heartopia x My Little Pony Phase 1 collaboration content is also returning. The Heartopia x My Little Pony Collaboration Phase 2 event begins today and runs until December 27, 2026.
title: Heartopia × My Little Pony - Official Collaboration Phase 2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms trailer for Arknights: Endfield, the hit action RPG developed by Hypergryph. Recently, the citizens of Wuling have reported rather puzzling and confusing hallucinations. You decide to investigate the incident. Perhaps a wondrous encounter awaits. The Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms update for Arknights: Endfield launches on November 25, 2026.
title: Arknights: Endfield - Official 'Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the demo announcement trailer for Madness Survivors: A Case Gone Dark, a Lovecraftian co-op action roguelike developed by Wild Shape Games. Players will face the ancient horrors of an awakened God. Fight eldritch monstrosities, gather clues, and plunge into the madness. Madness Survivors: A Case Gone Dark is coming soon to PC, with a demo launching on Steam on December 3, 2026.
title: Madness Survivors: A Case Gone Dark - Official Demo Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay from Darkest Dungeon 2: The Butcher's Asylum in this trailer for the upcoming DLC. The Butcher's Asylum DLC is a standalone game mode for the gothic roguelike game, which brings endless waves of battle, a new playable hero, and new game features. 

Survive the bloodthirsty whims of a mad crowd! The Butcher’s Asylum invites one and all to step into the spotlight against endless hordes of enemies in a self-contained gladiatorial arena designed to test the player’s mental and physical fortitude.

Darkest Dungeon 2 is out now on PC/Mac/Linux (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. The Butcher's Asylum DLC for Darkest Dungeon 2 will be available on PC and consoles in early 2027.
title: Darkest Dungeon 2: The Butcher's Asylum - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Wuthering Waves launches its brand-new Chapter of the Year “Embers of the Everbright” on December 22nd (UTC+8). In Version 4.0, players will meet two playable Resonators, Anna and Lucielle, and pilot the wearable mech “Strider Mechsuit” with full 360-degree mobility and dive straight into exploration and combat. Rover’s next adventure begins at Buffalo Rock, where a new journey through the New Federation awaits. The footage was captured from a test build and does not reflect the final quality of the game.
title: Wuthering Waves: Embers of the Everbright - Official Gameplay Reveal

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the unsettling world and gameplay from Eldritch Empathy in this trailer for the upcoming Lovecraftian narrative horror game. Something stirs behind the veil of reality. Unravel the secrets of otherworldly entities in Eldritch Empathy. Solve puzzles, research the unknown, and try to maintain your sanity at all costs! Eldritch Empathy will be available on Steam in 2027.
title: Eldritch Empathy - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Robo Fight, a strategy robot auto-battling simulation game developed by Drix Dev. Players will take part in the robot-fighting tournament of the ages, with parts to swap out, programs to initiate, and more. Robo Fight is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Robo Fight - Official Demo Launch Trailer
